sheet.title: A landscape rectangle
sheet.instruction: Lay a 3 × 2 sheet with a long edge facing you. Four equal bands will run across its width.
sheet.result: The sheet lies flat with its long edges horizontal.

stack-far.title: Fold the far quarter
stack-far.instruction: Bring the far edge over to the centerline.
stack-far.result: Two bands meet face to face.

stack-middle.title: Reverse at the middle
stack-middle.instruction: Carry both far bands behind the sheet at the centerline.

stack-near.title: Close the accordion
stack-near.instruction: Fold the stack toward you along the near quarter line, keeping the short ends even.
stack-near.result: Four plies form one narrow strip.

mark-west.title: Mark diagonal 1
mark-west.instruction: On the near edge measure 1/12 of the strip length from the left. On the far edge measure 2/12. Join those points and fold the left end over.
mark-west.result: One oblique crease crosses all four plies.

unmark-west.title: Reopen diagonal 1
unmark-west.instruction: Swing the folded end back without opening the long accordion.
unmark-west.result: The strip is straight again and keeps mark 1.

mark-west-middle.title: Mark diagonal 2
mark-west-middle.instruction: On the near edge measure 4/12 of the strip length from the left. On the far edge measure 5/12. Join those points and fold the left end behind.
mark-west-middle.result: One oblique crease crosses all four plies.

unmark-west-middle.title: Reopen diagonal 2
unmark-west-middle.instruction: Swing the folded end back without opening the long accordion.
unmark-west-middle.result: The strip is straight again and keeps mark 2.

mark-east-middle.title: Mark diagonal 3
mark-east-middle.instruction: On the near edge measure 7/12 of the strip length from the left. On the far edge measure 8/12. Join those points and fold the right end over.
mark-east-middle.result: One oblique crease crosses all four plies.

unmark-east-middle.title: Reopen diagonal 3
unmark-east-middle.instruction: Swing the folded end back without opening the long accordion.
unmark-east-middle.result: The strip is straight again and keeps mark 3.

mark-east.title: Mark diagonal 4
mark-east.instruction: On the near edge measure 10/12 of the strip length from the left. On the far edge measure 11/12. Join those points and fold the right end behind.
mark-east.result: One oblique crease crosses all four plies.

unmark-east.title: Reopen diagonal 4
unmark-east.instruction: Swing the folded end back without opening the long accordion.
unmark-east.result: The strip is straight again and keeps mark 4.

release-near.title: Open the near band
release-near.instruction: Undo the last long fold and hold the other bands together.

release-middle.title: Open the middle band
release-middle.instruction: Bring the buried packet forward around the centerline.

release-far.title: Open the far band
release-far.instruction: Open the remaining pair and smooth the sheet lightly.
release-far.result: Four zigzags cross the three transverse creases.

gather-ridges.title: Gather the ridges
gather-ridges.instruction: From the left, raise the first and third zigzags and lower the second and fourth. Bring the sides together and let each crosswise crease reverse at the next zigzag.
gather-ridges.result: Two raised chevrons alternate with two troughs. The map is shorter in both directions.
